change_summary: Add tool-efficiency guidance to reuse fetched order data, parallelize independent lookups, and deduplicate product/order calls.
reason_for_change: get_order_details and get_product_details dominate tool usage; order payloads already contain item_ids/details, so instructing the agent to reuse fetched data, avoid redundant product lookups, and parallelize independent calls should reduce mean tool_calls and cost per task while preserving correctness (efficiency explicitly subordinated to policy/success).
reason_accepted_or_rejected: rejected: first proxy run did not improve — no cost improvement beyond noise: per-task cost 0.629435 >= threshold 0.549781 (best mean 0.580574 - 1σ·0.030793)
hypothesis: The agent re-fetches product details it could infer or already partially has, and issues one get_product_details per item serially; instructing it to parallelize/deduplicate lookups already present in fetched order data reduces tool calls.
